title: RNA extraction for the Betta splendens genome
author: Kailong Ma
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qvfdw3n
materials: 1. Pour 1.5ml TRIZOL reagent. 2. For tissue samples, grind about 60mg with liquid nitrogen into powder and transfer the powder samples into the 2 ml tube contain of 1.5ml Trizol reagent. TRIZOL reagent Invitrogen - Thermo Fisher Catalog #15596-026

1. Transfer the aqueous phase to a new 1.5mL tube; add equal volume of supernatant of isopropyl alcohol. Mixing well and place at -20°C for 2 hours for precipitation. 2. Centrifuge at 13600rpm for 20 minutes at 4°C and remove the supernatant. 02:00:00, 1 00:20:00, 2 isopropyl alcohol Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #W292907

1. Centrifuge at 12000×g for 5 minutes at 4°C.Transfer the supernatant to a new 2.0ml tube, add 0.3 ml of Chloroform / isoamyl alcohol(24:1) per 1.5 ml of Trizol reagent. Shake the tubes vigorously for 15 seconds. 2. Centrifuge at 12000×g for 10 minutes at 4°C. After centrifugation, the mixture should separates into three layers: the lower phenol-chloroform phase, an interphase, and an upper aqueous phase. RNA remaims in the aqueous phase. 00:05:00, 1(1) 00:00:15, 1(2) 00:10:00, 2 Chloroform / isoamyl alcohol(24:1) Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #319988/W205702

steps.title: Homogenize and Dissociate Sample
steps.instruction: Homogenize the sample for 2 minutes and let it rest horizontally for 5 minutes to allow complete dissociation of nucleoprotein complexes.

steps.title: Wash RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet twice using 75% ethanol and centrifuge to isolate the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet with 1 ml 75% ethanol
Re-suspend the pellet and centrifuge at 13600rpm for 3 minutes at 4°C
Repeat the wash and centrifugation step once more
Completely remove the ethanol without disturbing the pellet

steps.title: Dry RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Air-dry the RNA pellet inside a biosafety cabinet.

steps.title: Dissolve RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Dissolve the RNA pellet using 50µL of DEPC-treated water (Ambion Catalog #AM9915G).
